Profile saved callback retains cache/tab refresh while its accepted parent signal moves into the record hook. These are intentional timing changes requiring actual runtime proof.

Member creation emits constant accepted metadata before alive()/fallible child result use. Read-only Use existing emits no mutation signal. Optional reference notifications propagate unit/member/record changes through enclosing profiles, editors and importers; child close adapters are no-op so only final owner closes the retained lifecycle.

Actual confirmed unit references conditionally invoke the existing complete fallback GET helper at final outer close. Ordinary record/import/member changes do not acquire that reference read. No month-active board list is substituted for complete fallback membership, and no assignment/count is fabricated for a new unposted member.

All existing template literals and table/form literal contents are exact across five held files. Main37tables/14forms remain exact; member/import/record counts are reported per file. No CSS/font/status factory/visual markup edits. All100 semantic color anchor text groups remain exact with explicit current-to-candidate line bridges.

API request expressions and confirmation/serialization/storage expressions remain exact. Existing full Leave cancellation and monthly approval branches preserve their owner guards, confirmations, known-confirmed disabled-state behavior and retained readback callbacks byteexact.
